# Change manifest reference

A change manifest says what changed between two versions of an agent, for `driftbench radius --change`; see [blast radius](../concepts/blast-radius.md). The page lists every field, generated from the zod schemas the CLI uses.

* Keys are snake_case. An unknown key is an error.
* Descriptions come from the schemas. An empty cell means the schema has no description for that field yet.

## Contents

* [ChangeManifest](#changemanifest)
* [Change](#change)
* [ToolPart](#toolpart)

## ChangeManifest

What changed in the agent between two versions.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string, not empty | yes |  | The agent version before the change. |
| `to` | string, not empty | yes |  | The agent version after the change. |
| `changes` | list of [Change](#change) | yes |  | Every change made between the two versions. |

## Change

One change to the agent.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string, not empty | yes |  | What changed: one of stage, tool, rule, deviation, prompt, map, fixture, criterion, model, agent, prompt_section. Another kind is the whole suite. |
| `id` | string, not empty | no |  | Which one: a stage, a tool label, a rule (states@<stage>, recovery:<class>, uses_tool:<tool>, path:<id>, reply_language, or a spec rule name), a deviation class, an estate atom id, dimension=value of the map, a fixture name or value, a criterion name, or a prompt section as <prompt-id>#<section-id>. |
| `part` | [ToolPart](#toolpart) | no |  | For a tool: input, result, description or presence. Absent: any part. |
| `global` | boolean | no |  | True when the change applies to every block, such as a tone rule. The whole suite. |
| `note` | string | no |  | A free note for the reader. |

## ToolPart

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `input` | The arguments the tool takes. In the radius: blocks that expect a call or assert on its input, and specs whose max_calls caps it. |
| `result` | What the tool returns. In the radius: blocks that expect a call, force its result or error, or read its end state. |
| `description` | The text that tells the agent what the tool does. In the radius: every block that lists the tool, count 0 included. |
| `presence` | Whether the agent is offered the tool at all. In the radius: every block that lists the tool, count 0 included. |
